payload.text: Determinism rule — `norm_cdf_deep_tail_matches_reference` pins `norm_cdf` against high-precision reference values deep in the left tail: Φ(−1)=0.15865525393145705, Φ(−5)=2.866515718791939e-7, Φ(−10)=7.619853024160525e-24, each via `assert_close!` with explicit rel/abs tolerances (never `==`). Because `norm_cdf` routes through `libm::erfc` (correctly-rounded), these exact-digit references encode the bit-stable, cross-platform tail behaviour; a regression that dropped the erfc routing (reintroducing catastrophic cancellation) would fail here. Pure test: evaluates norm_cdf and asserts, no mutation.
